Square-format cinematic dark-fantasy digital illustration showing five armored adventurers confronting dragons on a shattered volcanic battlefield. Center foreground, a tall warrior in elaborate black-and-gold spiked plate armor and a horned full-face helmet stands wide-legged on cracked obsidian rock. A torn deep-purple cape streams behind him. He grips an enormous glowing violet two-handed sword angled diagonally from lower center toward the upper-right corner; the translucent blade is surrounded by purple lightning, sparks, and magical plasma.

At lower left, a pale red-haired woman in dark steel armor crouches inside a luminous spherical barrier of water and ice, holding a long blue-glowing spear or sword diagonally downward. Waves, ice shards, and white-blue spray curl around the bubble. Behind her, a dark-skinned male warrior in black armor and a green hooded cloak thrusts a silver sword toward the left edge.

Behind the central knight, a dark-haired male mage in ornate navy-and-gold robes holds a tall staff topped with a bright blue crystalline diamond and circular arcane rings. His raised free hand conjures a compact orange flame. At lower right, a pale white-haired female warrior in revealing black spiked armor kneels dynamically on a rock ledge, raising a double-bladed black battle axe overhead while extending a narrow sword down and right.

A colossal blue-black dragon’s head dominates the upper-left, facing inward with one electric-blue eye and a wide-open mouth full of long ivory fangs, glowing icy blue from within. A second enormous black dragon head fills the upper-right, its mouth glowing molten orange amid smoke and fire. A smaller winged dragon flies in the storm clouds near the top center.

The environment is split into opposing elemental palettes: icy cobalt blue, water, and crystalline energy on the left; blazing orange lava, embers, flames, and a burning gothic city with needle-like towers on the right. Jagged black rocks and glowing lava fissures fill the foreground. Dense charcoal storm clouds cover the sky. Dramatic high-contrast lighting, glossy metallic armor, intricate engraved details, sharp textures, saturated blue-orange-purple magical effects, epic video-game key art, highly detailed photorealistic digital painting. No visible text.
